description:
About the Studio Tour
Our Studio Tour brings you closer than ever to the entertainment you love. You’ll explore one of the busiest working studios in Los Angeles with one of our expert Tour Guides, who will take you behind the scenes of the studio that has been entertaining the world for over 100 years. Available in English or Spanish.
Tour Duration: 3 hours total (1-hour tour with guide + 2 hours self-guided, shopping & dining)
About the TCM Classic Films Tour
Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood and Turner Classic Movies (TCM) have partnered up to introduce the TCM Classic Films Tour.   This new tour features bespoke clips from TCM hosts, visits to areas of the lot that are not part of the regular tour (including the Property Department and Rose Garden), and TCM-branded tour carts.  This classics-themed tour focuses on the Golden Age of Film and TV, featuring award-winning titles that shot on the iconic backlot from the early days of the Studio through the 1970s.
A specially trained Tour Guide, with the help of the hosts from Turner Classic Movies, will guide guests through the Studio Tour themed to iconic classic movies and TV shows from the early days of the Studio through the 1970’s. While on tour, guests will visit the familiar places and spaces where movie magic has been happening for more than 100 years. Available in English.
Tour Duration: 3 1/2 hours total (1.5-hour tour with guide + 2 hours self-guided, shopping & dining)

faqs.question: What tour options are available for the Studio Tour at Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood?
faqs.answer: There are three tour options available: a Studio Tour for One in English, a Studio Tour for One in Spanish, and a TCM Classic Films Tour for One. Guests can select the option that best suits their language preference or area of interest.

faqs.question: Where is Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood located?
faqs.answer: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood is located at 3400 Warner Blvd, Burbank, CA 91505. The tour takes place on-site at the Warner Bros. Studio.

faqs.question: How long do visitors typically spend at the Studio Tour at Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood?
faqs.answer: Visitors typically spend between 3 to 5 hours at the tour. The experience includes both guided portions led by a tour guide and a section where visitors can free roam and view props and sets independently.

faqs.question: What franchises and sets can visitors see during the Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood?
faqs.answer: The tour includes photo opportunities with props and sets from multiple franchises including Harry Potter, Batman, Friends, and DC Comics. The tour also features Harry Potter interactive exhibits for guests to engage with.

faqs.question: Is the Studio Tour at Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood guided or self-directed?
faqs.answer: The tour is led by a tour guide who accompanies visitors through the experience. There is also a portion of the tour where visitors can free roam and explore props and sets on their own.
